design_notes: Use serif fonts throughout (e.g., Georgia for body, Miller for headings).
Accent colour: a muted blue (#2C5F8A) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Tables: hairline rules, alternating row shading (very light grey #F5F5F5) for readability.
Pull-quote: set in larger italic serif, with a thick left rule in accent colour.
Sidebar: boxed with a thin border, background tint #FAFAFA, title in small caps.
No icons, no images, no decorative elements.
